raw_segments.text: Yego, I do beseech you, though I perchance am vicious in my guess, as I confess, it is
my nature's plague to spy into abuses, and of my jealousy shapes faults that are not,
that your wisdom from one that so imperfectly conceits would take no notice, nor build yourself
a trouble out of his scattering and unsure observance.
